note: These are experience dimensions used to build metaphorical AV overlays. They are not diagnostic criteria. Evidence strength & rationale docs were added based on the deep research reports (2026-02-15).

dimensions.label: Hyperarousal
dimensions.description: Elevated baseline alertness, physiological tension, and readiness to react.
safety: Prefer smooth modulation; avoid flicker; keep audio dynamics gentle.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Hypervigilance
dimensions.description: Scanning for threats, narrowed attention, heightened sensitivity to cues.
safety: Avoid jump-scares; use subtle focus narrowing and noise, not sudden spikes.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Panic Peaks
dimensions.description: Sudden waves of intense fear or bodily alarm that rise and fall.
safety: Provide strong user control; cap intensity; avoid strobing or harsh audio.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Rumination Loop
dimensions.description: Repetitive, sticky thought loops; difficulty disengaging.
safety: Make loops subtle; avoid hypnotic flashing patterns; provide an easy stop.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Intrusion
safety: No graphic content; use abstract interference textures with conservative limits.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Emotional Numbing
dimensions.description: Reduced emotional intensity, dampened reward/interest, muted affect.
safety: Keep visuals gentle; avoid making 'numbness' look like moral failure.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Cognitive Fog
dimensions.description: Slowed thinking, reduced clarity, difficulty sustaining mental effort.
safety: Prefer softness and subtle blur; avoid disorienting motion.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Time Dilation
dimensions.description: Time feels slowed, accelerated, or uneven.
safety: Offer Reduced Motion; cap temporal feedback effects.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Derealization
dimensions.description: The world feels unreal, distant, 'behind glass'.
safety: Use mild ghosting/chroma drift; avoid intense warping.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Depersonalization
dimensions.description: Feeling detached from the self or body; reduced sense of agency.
safety: Avoid unsettling body distortions; keep it subtle and user-controlled.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Sensory Overload
dimensions.description: Too much input at once; difficulty filtering sensory signals.
safety: Never default to harsh intensity; provide quick calming toggles.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Attention Fragmentation
dimensions.description: Attention jumps between stimuli; difficulty stabilizing focus.
safety: Use gentle jitter; avoid nausea-inducing motion.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.

dimensions.label: Compulsive Loop
dimensions.description: Urge to repeat actions/mental checks; 'stuckness' in a loop.
safety: Do not portray as comedic; keep loop cues minimal and controllable.
Hard limits: no flicker/strobe; no sudden loud transients; keep effects user-controlled; provide Reduced Motion and Safe Mode.
